steps.say: Break clauses for tenancies of two years or more let either side need to end the tenancy early. They bring the tenancy to an end before the fixed term with set written notice periods.

The tenant gives 3 months’ notice in writing, but not in the first 3 months, so the earliest end is after 6 months. The landlord has a one-off break at 6 months, a receiver break with at least 2 months’ notice after month 4, and a sale process with first notice after month 2 and end at least 4 months after that first notice and 2 months after the break notice. Overpaid rent is repaid to the tenant within 14 days after the end if vacated.

As background, think of month zero as the start date in clause B4.1. Mark month 2 for the sale intention notice, month 3 when tenant notice becomes allowed, month 4 for receiver notice, and month 6 for the earliest tenant end and landlord 6-month break, plus 14 days after the end for repayment.
